fields.statement: QA cycle 2, scratch build (go build -trimpath) in a hermetic Rhiza root with fake rex/claude: agent step invoke using every placeholder rendered as the first prompt ({leaf}/{attempt} empty, {brief}/{slice}/{handback} the session's build-1/agent/ paths); leaves builder at attempts 2 and 3 got rendered invoke then the attempt line; checks step check and critic invoke with {leaf}/{attempt} (the cycle-2 fix) pass workflow check and render empty; leaf fixer got rendered invoke with {leaf} and {attempt} then its confirmed-findings lines, change set fixer the same with {leaf} empty and Review: trailer line. workflow check refuses {check} in a fixer and a builder, {cycle} in an agent step, {bogus} in a critic handback, prompt+invoke on a verifier, handback on a command step, each naming it (exit 1). Scoped tests TestInvokeTemplate, TestInvokePrompt, TestScripts/workflow-invoke ok.

QA cycle 2: advisor sessions started by real failing leaves and checks runs (scratch build) got RHIZA_BRIEF/RHIZA_SLICE under .git/rhiza/runs/<run>/advisor/<session id>/ with brief.md, prompt the usual advisor text; arbiter covered by go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestArbiterBrief|TestAdvisorBrief' ok.

QA cycle 2: scratch-built rhiza guide contract prints obligations with gates, every invoke placeholder incl. {leaf}/{attempt} on check/critic and {attempt} on fixer, the RHIZA_ variables incl. BRIEF/SLICE/HANDBACK and the three files (exit 0); every role topic (advisor, arbiter, builder, check-*, critic, fixer, ci/gate/conflict-fix, planner, plan-critic/reviewer/reviser, verifier) names rhiza guide contract; unknown topic exits 4 with a next line. go test ./internal/guide -run TestContract ok.

QA cycle 2: session dirs seen on real runs: build-1/agent, l-1/builder-<leaf>-<attempt>, review-1/<check>-check-1, <check>-critic-1, fixer-<leaf>-<cycle>-<attempt>, fixer-<cycle>-<attempt>, all distinct across cycles and attempts, under .git/rhiza/runs outside the worktree, kept after the run. brief.md has sections in order, both leaves with acceptance, the change set's own decision and constraint (the cycle-2 fix), rhiza.ship.localGate and the contract summary ending 'Full contract: rhiza guide contract'; seven briefs of one model byte-identical. go test ./internal/run -run 'TestBriefFiles|TestSessionDir|TestHandbackFile' ok.

QA cycle 2: agent, builder, check, critic and both fixer sessions each got RHIZA_BRIEF and RHIZA_SLICE (no RHIZA_HANDBACK, no handback.md); slice.json byte-equal to rhiza slice --json run inside the session; an unwritable runs/<id> (a file at the path) fails the run naming the session directory path and starts no agent. go test ./internal/api -run TestSessionBrief and TestScripts/brief-files ok.
